build_BBoxHead: build a BBoxHead instance with configurable classification and regression layers for RoI features
forward_BBoxHead: run the BBoxHead forward pass to get classification scores and bbox predictions from RoI features
loss_BBoxHead: calculate classification and regression loss using predicted scores, bbox deltas, and ground truth targets
predict_by_feat_BBoxHead: transform extracted RoI features into final detection results with NMS post-processing
refine_bboxes_BBoxHead: refine bounding boxes during training using predicted scores and regression deltas for Cascade R-CNN
